instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/seed_ss_gui_11_arc_notch.dxf and continue editing that drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Use the existing rectangle and construction marks to create the final 120 x 80 rectangular outer outline. Add one semicircular notch in the middle of the top edge, radius 15, with circle center at (60,80). Add two bottom holes of diameter 8 with centers at (25,20) and (95,20). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_11.dxf.
